clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope  -  Lays  down dimensions ,shape and  other requirements of crane rail sections.

clauses.title: Designation – By letters
clauses.text: 2. Designation - By letters ISCR followed by head width of the rail section in mm.

clauses.title: Tensile Properties – Steel
clauses.text: 3. Tensile Properties - Steel shall have a minimum tensile strength of 710 MPa with a minimum elongationof 14 pernent on a gauge length of 5.65  where So is the area  of cross-section of specimen

clauses.title: Freedom from Defects
clauses.text: 5. Freedom from Defects — Shall be free from twist. Camber shall not exceed  0.2  percent of length. The asymmetry of rail cross section with respect to vertical axis shall not exceed 2 mm and 0.6 mm in rail flange and head respectively. SUMMARY OF IS 3443 : 1980  CRANE RAIL SECTION (First Revision)
